status: UNSIGNED DRAFT: nothing here has been run for acceptance
procedure: P1: one-sided Student t(G-1) on the CR1 statistic (reviewer-directed prospective selection, 2026-10-24)

sensitivity.note: a1 (rho 0.6) is run at 50,000 datasets per G, all K3/K6/K16 outcomes reported, excluded from the mandatory verdict, never used to redefine the operating domain

generators.definition: a0: iid N(0,1) G x 16; a1: sqrt(rho) f_g + sqrt(1-rho) z; b0: z * s_g, s = exp(linspace(0, ln scale_ratio, G)); b1: session distribution cycles normal / t3 (unit variance) / centred lognormal sigma 1 (unit variance) by session index mod 3, times s_g; all true mean 0; SplitMix64 Box-Muller normals; drawn in chunks of `chunk` datasets from one stream per cell in the order z, then f (a1) or the chi-square normals (b1)

stop_rules.crash_policy: an interrupted run may be resumed exactly as declared in `resume`; nothing else is permitted
stop_rules.fail_policy: a failed evaluation is recorded; no tuning, no rerun with new seeds under this prereg

decision_rule: overall PASS iff every one of the 27 mandatory evaluations (a0, b0, b1 x G 5, 7, 10 x K 3, 6, 16) has UCB95 <= fwer_target, i.e. count <= k_max(n_per_cell); a1 is reported and is not a criterion; a NaN p counts as p = 1 and any NaN is reported; pass supports calibration under the synthetic regimes only, never a real-data claim; serial dependence is outside the validated domain; the report lists the 27 mandatory and the 9 sensitivity results separately; a statistical pass does NOT automatically close F3 or authorise real-data claims (the outside reviewer decides)
data_versions_sentinel: synthetic-no-data: a declared sentinel only. NO market data are consumed (no data/real access, no holdout registry, no dataset reader); it is not a dataset identifier and not a holdout exemption

frozen_in_identity: ordering of draws within a chunk

resume.validation: every finished cell file is re-verified by deterministic recomputation under the CURRENT verified signed identity: identity_sha256 of the full analysis_identity block, prereg sha256, seed, chunk, n, final RNG state and chunk-count digest must all match; any mismatch refuses
resume.failed_study: a completed run whose DECISION.json says FAIL is final: no resume, no rerun, no new seeds under this prereg (a new prereg and independent approval are required)
